title: HİP: a privacy-preserving, unique-code-based mobile application for asynchronous multi-physician clinical data collection
description:
A cross-platform mobile application (Flutter, Firebase) in which several physicians contribute structured clinical data for one patient under a shared 20-character alphanumeric code, each within their own specialty category and asynchronously. The system tracks which contributions remain pending and exports the consolidated record as a two-column spreadsheet matching the input schema of the decision support system it serves.

Authorisation is enforced server-side by versioned, deny-by-default Firestore security rules, exercised by 62 emulator-based scenarios under eleven headings covering both permitted and refused operations. The rules file and the test suite in this archive are the versions in force on the live project.

This archive accompanies the manuscript of the same title. The Google Play listing is titled "HİP — Hekim İletişim Platformu", a name retained from the project's first phase; the system is a data-collection layer rather than a messaging tool.
